R01R_A_AGECAT7: DERIVED - Age range when interviewed (7 levels)

  Long Description: Age range at the time of interview.

  Algorithm:

  STEP1: Create intermediate variable R01R_A_AGE: IF (R01_AM0001 != .) THEN R01R_A_AGE =
  R01_AdultInterviewDT (Adult Interview Date) - R01_AM0001 (Date of Birth); ELSE IF
  (R01_AM0002 > 0) THEN R01R_A_AGE = R01_AM0002 (Adult Age in Years).

  STEP2: Create R01R_A_AGECAT7: If R01R_A_AGE < 0 and R01_AM0003 = 2 THEN R01R_A_AGECAT7
  = 1; ELSE IF R01R_A_AGE < 0 and R01_AM0003 = 3 THEN R01R_A_AGECAT7 = 2; ELSE IF
  (18 <= R01R_A_AGE <= 24) then R01R_A_AGECAT7 = 1; ELSE IF (25 <= R01R_A_AGE <= 34)
  THEN R01R_A_AGECAT7 = 2; ELSE IF (35 <= R01R_A_AGE <= 44) THEN R01R_A_AGECAT7 = 3;
  ELSE IF (45 <= R01R_A_AGE <= 54) THEN R01R_A_AGECAT7 = 4; ELSE IF (55 <= R01R_A_AGE <= 64)
  THEN R01R_A_AGECAT7 = 5; ELSE IF (65 <= R01R_A_AGE <= 74) THEN R01R_A_AGECAT7 = 6; ELSE IF
  (75 <= R01R_A_AGE) THEN R01R_A_AGECAT7 = 7; ELSE IF (R01_AM0003 = -9 OR R01_AM0002 = -9
  OR R01_AM0001 = -9) THEN R01R_A_AGECAT7 = -99999; ELSE IF (R01_AM0003 = -8 OR R01_AM0002 =
  -8 OR R01_AM0001 = -8) THEN R01R_A_AGECAT7 = -99988; ELSE IF (R01_AM0003 = -7 OR R01_AM0002
  = -7 OR R01_AM0001 = -7) THEN R01R_A_AGECAT7 = -99977;

R01_AX0161: Last time you had significant problems with: Feeling very trapped, lonely, sad,
blue, depressed or hopeless about the future

   The following questions are about common psychological, behavioral, and personal problems.
   These problems are considered significant when you have them for two or more weeks, when
   they keep coming back, when they keep you from meeting your responsibilities, or when they
   make you feel like you can't go on.

   After each of the following questions, please tell us the last time, if ever, you had the
   problem, by answering whether it was in the past month, 2-12 months ago, over a year ago,

  Long Description: Age range at the time of interview

  Original Variables: R02_AM0003

  Algorithm: [STEP1: Create intermediate variable R02R_A_AGE: ]IF R02_NEW_BASELINE_ADULT_LD = 1 THEN DO;
  IF (R02_AM0001 != .) THEN R02R_A_AGE = (R02_AdultInterviewDT[Adult Wave 2 Interview Date] - R02_AM0001);
  ELSE IF R01_CPT07 != . THEN R02R_A_AGE = (R02_AdultInterviewDT - R01_CPT07[Wave 1 Youth Date of Birth]) ;
  ELSE IF R02_AM0002 > 0 THEN R02R_A_AGE = R02_AM0002; ELSE IF R01_AM0002=-9 OR R01_CPT07 = . THEN
  R02R_A_AGE=-99999; ELSE IF R01_AM0002=-8 THEN R02R_A_AGE=-99988; ELSE IF R01_AM0002=-7 THEN
  R02R_A_AGE=-99977; END; ELSE IF R02_CONTINUING_ADULT_LD = 1 THEN DO; IF (R02_AM0001 != .) THEN
  R02R_A_AGE = (R02_AdultInterviewDT[Adult Wave 2 Interview Date] - R02_AM0001); ELSE IF R02_AM0002 > 0
  THEN R02R_A_AGE = R02_AM0002; ELSE IF R01_AM0001 != . THEN R02R_A_AGE = (R02_AdultInterviewDT - R01_AM0001
  [Wave 1 Adult Date of Birth]); ELSE IF R01_AM0002=-9 THEN R02R_A_AGE=-99999; ELSE IF R01_AM0002=-8 THEN
  R02R_A_AGE=-99988; ELSE IF R01_AM0002=-7 THEN R02R_A_AGE=-99977; END; IF R02R_A_AGE > 90 THEN
  R02R_A_AGE = 90; [STEP2: Create R02R_A_AGECAT7:]IF R02R_A_AGE < 0 AND R02_AM0003 = 2 THEN R02R_A_AGECAT7
  = 1; ELSE IF R02R_A_AGE < 0 and R02_AM0003 = 3 THEN R02R_A_AGECAT7 = 2; ELSE IF (18 <= R02R_A_AGE <= 24)
  THEN R02R_A_AGECAT7 = 1; ELSE IF (25 <= R02R_A_AGE <= 34) THEN R02R_A_AGECAT7 = 2; ELSE IF (35 <=
  R02R_A_AGE <= 44) THEN R02R_A_AGECAT7 = 3; ELSE IF (45 <= R02R_A_AGE <= 54) THEN R02R_A_AGECAT7 = 4;
  ELSE IF (55 <= R02R_A_AGE <= 64) THEN R02R_A_AGECAT7 = 5; ELSE IF (65 <= R02R_A_AGE <= 74) THEN
  R02R_A_AGECAT7 = 6; ELSE IF (75 <= R02R_A_AGE) THEN R02R_A_AGECAT7 = 7; ELSE IF (R02_AM0003 = -9 OR
  R02_AM0002 = -9 OR R02_AM0001 = -9) THEN R02R_A_AGECAT7 = -99999; ELSE IF (R02_AM0003 = -8 OR
  R02_AM0002 = -8 OR R02_AM0001 = -8) THEN R02R_A_AGECAT7 = -99988; ELSE IF (R02_AM0003 = -7 OR
  R02_AM0002 = -7 OR R02_AM0001 = -7) THEN R02R_A_AGECAT7 = -99977;

3:codebook:R03R_A_AGECAT7.section_text:
R03R_A_AGECAT7: DERIVED - Age range at the time of interview (7 levels)

  Long Description: Age range at the time of interview

  Algorithm: [STEP 1: Create R03R_A_AGE]IF (R03_AM0001 != .) THEN R03R_A_AGE =
  R03_AdultInterviewDT (Adult Wave 3 Interview Date) - R03_AM0001; ELSE IF (R03_AM0002
  != -1) THEN R03R_A_AGE = R03_AM0002; ELSE IF (R03_ADULTTYPE = 1 AND R02_AM0001 != .)
  THEN R03R_A_AGE = R03_AdultInterviewDT - R02_AM0001 (Wave 2 Adult Corrected Date
  of Birth); ELSE IF (R03_ADULTTYPE = 1 AND R01_AM0001 != .) THEN R03R_A_AGE =
  R03_AdultInterviewDT - R01_AM0001 (Wave 1 Adult Date of Birth); ELSE IF
  (R03_ADULTTYPE = 2 AND R02_CPT06 (Wave 2 Youth Corrected Date of Birth) != . THEN
  R03R_A_AGE = R03_AdultInterviewDT - R02_CPT06; ELSE IF (R03_ADULTTYPE = 2 AND
  R01_CPT07 (Wave 1 Youth Date of Birth) != . THEN R03R_A_AGE = R03_AdultInterviewDT -
  R01_CPT07; [STEP 2: Create R03R_A_AGECAT7]IF (18 <= R03R_A_AGE <= 24) THEN
  R03R_A_AGECAT7 = 1; ELSE IF (25 <= R03R_A_AGE <= 34) THEN R03R_A_AGECAT7 = 2; ELSE IF
  (35 <= R03R_A_AGE <= 44) THEN R03R_A_AGECAT7 = 3; ELSE IF (45 <= R03R_A_AGE <= 54)
  THEN R03R_A_AGECAT7 = 4; ELSE IF (55 <= R03R_A_AGE <= 64) THEN R03R_A_AGECAT7 = 5;
  ELSE IF (65 <= R03R_A_AGE <= 74) THEN R03R_A_AGECAT7 = 6; ELSE IF (75 <= R03R_A_AGE)
  THEN R03R_A_AGECAT7 = 7; ELSE IF (R02_AM0003 = -9 OR R02_AM0002 = -9 OR R02_AM0001
  = -9) THEN R02R_A_AGECAT7= -99999; ELSE IF (R02_AM0003 = -8 OR R02_AM0002 = -8 OR

    IF R03_CAD10 = 1, use a standard algorithm to determine SP year of age on the date that the consent

    DOB entered)

    entered in years)
    ELSE, IF R03_AM0003 IN (1, 2, 3, 4), THEN SET R03_ACHIEVEDAGE TO (17, 21, 27, 30),
    respectively.

    Create a derived variable, called R03_ADULTTYPE as follows:
    IF R03_ACHIEVEDAGE > 17 AND (Scrn112_AssignmentStatus !NULL or Scrn212_AssignmentStatus
    !NULL), SET R03_ADULTTYPE = 1 (ContinuingAdult) AND GO TO R03_CAD08 (i.e., if 18+ and
    completed adult int in BL or W2, set as continuing adult)

    (Int133_AssignmentStatus !NULL AND Scrn212_AssignmentStatus = NULL)), SET R03_ADULTTYPE
    = 2 (NewBaselineAdult) AND GO TO R03_CAD15 (i.e., if 18+ and previously completed youth int in
    BL or W2, set as new adult)
    ELSE, IF R03_ACHIEVEDAGE < 18, GO TO R03_CAD28 (i.e., if under 18, then exit adult consent)

 BOX ID:             R04_CADBOX3_VR
  Create a derived variable, called R04_ACHIEVEDAGE, as follows:
  IF R04_CAD10=1, use a standard algorithm to determine SP year of age on the date that the consent
  is being administered, using R04_BestDOB. (i.e., If BestDOB confirmed)
  ELSE IF R04_AM0001 NOT IN (-8,-7), use a standard algorithm to determine SP year of age on the
  date that the consent is being administered, using DOB entered in R04_AM0001 (i.e., Else if New DOB
  entered)
  ELSE IF R04_AM0002 NOT IN (-8, -7), then use age entered in R04_AM0002 (i.e., Else if age entered
  in years)
  ELSE IF R04_AM0003 IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6), THEN SET R04_ACHIEVEDAGE TO (17, 21, 27, 37, 54,
  65), respectively.

  Create a derived variable, called R04_ADULTTYPE as follows:
  IF R04_ACHIEVEDAGE > 17 AND R04_CaseTYPE = 2, SET R04_ADULTTYPE = 3 (NewCohortAdult)
  AND GO TO R04_CAD15
  ELSE IF R04_ACHIEVEDAGE > 17 AND (Int112_AssignmentStatus !NULL or
  Int212_AssignmentStatus !NULL or R03_Scrn312_AssignmentStatus !NULL), SET R04_ADULTTYPE
  = 1 (ContinuingAdult) AND GO TO R04_CAD08 (i.e., if 18+ and completed adult int in Baseline, Wave
  2, or Wave 3, set as continuing adult)
  ELSE IF R04_ACHIEVEDAGE >17 AND (Int333_AssignmentStatus !NULL OR
  ((Int133_AssignmentStatus !NULL OR Int233_AssignmentStatus !NULL) AND
  Int212_AssignmentStatus = NULL AND R03_Scrn312_AssignmentStatus = NULL)), SET
  R04_ADULTTYPE = 2 (Aged-upAdult) AND GO TO R04_CAD15 (i.e., if 18+ and previously completed
  youth int in BL or W2, set as new adult)
  ELSE IF R04_ACHIEVEDAGE < 18, GO TO R04_CAD28 (i.e., if under 18, then exit adult consent)

BOX ID:       R05_AHV01
PROGRAM - DEFINE THE FOLLOWING USER GROUPS (SEE APPENDIX):

R05_HOOK_USER_STATUS = 1 (Current established user) Adult respondents who have ever
smoked hookah fairly regularly, and currently smoke every day, some days, weekly, monthly, or in the
past 30 days.
R05_HOOK_USER_STATUS = 2 (Current experimental user) Adult respondents who have never
smoked hookah fairly regularly, and currently smoke every day, some days, weekly, monthly, or in the
past 30 days.
R05_HOOK_USER_STATUS = 3 (Former experimental user) Adult respondents who have ever
smoked a hookah and have never smoked fairly regularly and did not smoke in the past 12 months or
currently smoke not at all.
R05_HOOK_USER_STATUS = 4 (Recent former established user) Continuing adult respondents who
were current established, current experimental, or former experimental hookah smokers as of their last
completed interview, have ever smoked fairly regularly, and did not smoke in the past 12 months or
currently smoke not at all; and new baseline adult respondents who have ever smoked hookah as of
their last completed interview, have ever smoked hookah fairly regularly, and did not smoke in the past
12 months or currently smoke not at all; and adult respondents who initiated hookah smoking since their
last completed interview, have ever smoked fairly regularly, have smoked in the past 12 months and
currently smoke not at all.
R05_HOOK_USER_STATUS = 5 (Long-term former established user) Continuing adult respondents
who were recent former established or long-term former established hookah smokers as of their last
completed interview and did not smoke in the past 12 months or currently smoke not at all.

R05_THIRTY_DAY_USER_HOOK = 1 (Past 30 day user) Adult respondents who have smoked hookah
in the past 30 days.
R05_HOOK_USER_STATUS = 1:
IF R05_EVER_NEVER_HOOK = 1 AND (R04_REGUSE_HOOK = 1 OR R05_AH1100 = 1) AND
(R05_AH1003 = 1, 2 OR R05_AH9003 = 1, 2, 3), THEN R05_HOOK_USER_STATUS = 1.
R05_HOOK_USER_STATUS = 2:
ELSE, IF R05_EVER_NEVER_HOOK = 1 AND R04_REGUSE_HOOK != 1 AND R05_AH1100 != 1 AND
(R05_AH1003 = 1, 2 OR R05_AH9003 = 1, 2, 3 OR (1 <= R05_AH1009_NN <= 30 AND
R05_AH1009_UN = 1) OR (R05_AH1009_NN = 1 AND R05_AH1009_UN = 2) OR R05_AH1004 = 1),
THEN R05_HOOK_USER_STATUS = 2.
R05_HOOK_USER_STATUS = 3:
ELSE, IF R05_EVER_NEVER_HOOK = 1 AND (R05_AH1002_12M = 2 OR R05_AH1003 = 3) AND
R05_AH1100 != 1 AND R04_REGUSE_HOOK != 1, THEN R05_HOOK_USER_STATUS = 3.
R05_HOOK_USER_STATUS = 4:
ELSE, IF (R04_HOOK_USER_STATUS = 1, 2, 3 OR R05_INIT_HOOK_ADULT = 1 OR
(R05_ADULTTYPE = 2 AND R04_EVER_NEVER_HOOK = 1)) AND (R04_REGUSE_HOOK = 1 OR
R05_AH1100 = 1) AND R05_EVER_NEVER_HOOK = 1 AND (R05_AH1002_12M = 2 OR
R05_AH1003 = 3), THEN R05_HOOK_USER_STATUS = 4.
R05_HOOK_USER_STATUS = 5:
ELSE, IF R04_HOOK_USER_STATUS = 4, 5 AND R05_EVER_NEVER_HOOK = 1 AND
(R05_AH1002_12M = 2 OR R05_AH1003 = 3), THEN R05_HOOK_USER_STATUS = 5.


R05_THIRTY_DAY_USER_HOOK = 1:
IF R05_EVER_NEVER_HOOK = 1 AND (((1 <= R05_AH1009_NN <= 30 AND R05_AH1009_UN = 1)
OR (R05_AH1009_NN = 1 AND R05_AH1009_UN = 2)) OR R05_AH1004 = 1), THEN
R05_THIRTY_DAY_USER_HOOK = 1.
ELSE, R05_THIRTY_DAY_USER_HOOK = 2.

hookah smokers as of their last completed interview, and did not smoke in the past 12 months or did not
smoke in the past 30 days and currently smoke not at all; and new baseline adult respondents who have
ever smoked hookah as of their last completed interview, and did not smoke in the past 12 months or did
not smoke in the past 30 days and currently smoke not at all; and adult respondents who initiated
hookah smoking since their last completed interview, and have not smoked in the past 12 months or did
not smoke in the past 30 days and currently smoke not at all.
R06_HOOK_USER_STATUS = 5 (Long-term former user) Continuing adult respondents who were
recent former or long-term former hookah smokers as of their last completed interview and did not
smoke in the past 12 months or did not smoke in the past 30 days and currently smoke not at all.

continue to be in the Adult cohort. This is not their first interview in the Adult cohort or the PATH Study.).
ELSE, IF R07R_A_AGE >= 18 AND A_PWAVE_COMP = 2 AND R07_CaseType = 1, SET
R07_ADULTTYPE = 2 (Aged-up Adult = Adult respondent whose last completed interview in a previous
wave was in the Youth cohort, and have now aged-up into the Adult cohort. This is their first interview in
the Adult cohort, but not their first interview in the PATH Study.).
ELSE, IF R07R_A_AGE >= 18 AND A_PWAVE_COMP = 2 AND R07_CaseType = 2, 4, 5, SET
R07_ADULTTYPE = 3 (New Cohort Adult = Adult respondent who is new to the PATH Study as part of
the replenishment sample. This is their first interview in the Adult cohort and in the PATH Study.).
